en.title: Coach Snap Wallet With Heart Bolt Print
en.description:
A compact Coach Snap Wallet With Heart Bolt Print for women with a playful lightning bolt and heart print. It combines Coach's signature style with a practical format for everyday use.
Inside there are bill compartments, 3 card slots and a clear ID window. The exterior zip pocket is handy for coins and small items. The wallet closes with a snap
